title: Jump Rope Workout Generator
description: Interval jump-rope workouts by level and duration, with a full round table.
howto: Choose your level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced.
Enter the total workout duration in minutes (5-60).
Follow the round table: exercise, work seconds, rest seconds, and elapsed time.

faqs.a: Beginner: 30s work / 30s rest; intermediate: 40s / 20s; advanced: 50s / 10s, with a warm-up and cool-down around the rounds.

faqs.q: What if my duration is short?
faqs.a: Warm-up and cool-down shrink automatically so at least one work round always fits.
Yes. Generating again with the same settings gives the same plan, so you can track progress.
